_note: 科研時事（站點級，跨科目）。顯示在三科總覽頁。cat 用 bio/chem/phys/math，只影響標籤顏色。越新的排越前。內容必須來自可靠來源並附連結——時事不是常識，寧可少寫也不要編。每天從泛科學、ScienceDaily、Nature 主刊精選 8 篇（單一來源最多 3 篇、單一科目最多 3 篇），本檔由 scripts/fetch_news.py 自動產生，可手動補充。

items.t: 物理學家捕捉反物質的突破可以解釋宇宙存在的原因
items.x: 正電子是電子的反物質對應物。物理學家捕獲了一個正電子並將其冷卻到接近絕對零度的溫度。正電子懸浮在一個無壁陷阱中，與普通物質安全隔離。團隊將對物質和反物質進行迄今為止最精確的比較。電子和正電子之間的任何差異都可能暴露粒子 p 標準模型中的裂縫
items.orig: Physicists trap antimatter in a breakthrough that could explain why the universe exists
items.origX: Positrons are the antimatter counterpart of an electron. Physicists trapped a positron and cooled it to temperatures near absolute zero. Positron is suspended in a wall-free trap, safely separated from ordinary matter. Team will conduct most precise comparison yet between matter and antimatter. Any difference between the electron and positron could expose cracks in the Standard Model of particle physics.

items.t: 用於全鈣鈦礦串聯太陽能電池的原位氧化還原轉換分子
items.x: 全鈣鈦礦串聯太陽能電池 (TSC) 因其超越單結鈣鈦礦太陽能電池 (PSC) 效率極限的能力而受到關注1,2。然而，全鈣鈦礦TSC的效率和穩定性受到錫鉛（Sn-Pb）窄帶隙子電池中電洞傳輸層/鈣鈦礦界面化學不穩定性的限制，這會引入深陷阱態
items.orig: An in situ redox-converted molecule for all-perovskite tandem solar cells
items.origX: All-perovskite tandem solar cells (TSCs) are gaining prominence due to their ability to surpass the efficiency limit of single-junction perovskite solar cells (PSCs)1,2. However, the efficiency and stability of all-perovskite TSCs are limited by chemical instability at the hole transport layer/perovskite interface in the tin-lead (Sn-Pb) narrow-bandgap subcell, which introduces deep trap states from tin cations and promotes non-radiative recombination3-5. Here we incorporate a redox-converted molecule of p-aminobenzohydrazide (ABH) into poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene):polystyrene sulfonate (PEDOT:PSS) that neutralizes PSS acidity, heals Sn4+ defects, and generates a dipole passivation effect upon oxidation. During the preparation of Sn-Pb perovskites, ABH suppresses interfacial oxidation by reducing Sn4+ defects and converts to p-aminobenzaldehyde (ABD), which suppresses photogenerated hole-induced Sn2+ oxidation, aligning energy levels for efficient hole extraction. The in situ redox-converted molecule stabilizes the buried interface during both device fabrication and operation, reduces non-radiative recombination and enhances stability. The resulting narrow-bandgap Sn-Pb PSC achieves a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 25.4% (certified 25.2%) with an open-circuit voltage of 0.92 V and a fill factor of 83.4%. Integrated into monolithic all-perovskite TSCs, the device delivers a PCE of 31.1% (certified 30.8%) together with enhanced thermal (ISOS-D-2I, 85 °C) and operational stability (ISOS-L-1I) under inert conditions.

items.t: 角膜太薄無法近視雷射？眼科醫師解析「植入式隱形眼鏡」EVO ICL，保留角膜且可隨時取出！
items.x: 高度近視或角膜太薄無法做近視雷射嗎？「EVO ICL植入式隱形眼鏡」保留完整角膜結構，不僅能降低術後乾眼風險，晶體更具備可取出的彈性，是視力矯正的安全新選擇。

items.t: 為什麼氫火焰會發出橙色光，然後幾乎看不見
items.x: 氫火焰可以從亮橙色轉變為幾乎看不見，這取決於一些意想不到的情況：空氣中漂浮著微量的鈉。科學家表示，這項發現可以透過用專門的感測器取代視覺火焰檢測來幫助未來的氫動力爐和烤箱更安全。
items.orig: Why hydrogen flames can glow orange, then turn nearly invisible
items.origX: Hydrogen flames can shift from bright orange to nearly invisible depending on something unexpected: tiny amounts of sodium floating in the air. Scientists say this discovery could help make future hydrogen-powered stoves and ovens safer by replacing visual flame detection with specialized sensors.

items.t: 動脈如何在過度生長誘導突變的情況下保持其形狀
items.x: 為什麼癌症相關突變會導致一些血管異常發育，但動脈卻不會？答案在於受影響細胞的身份和成熟度。
items.orig: How arteries keep their shape in the face of overgrowth-inducing mutations
items.origX: Why do cancer-associated mutations cause some blood vessels to develop abnormally, but not arteries? The answer lies in the identity and maturity of the affected cells.

items.t: 一年吞下5億顆安眠藥！大腦當機睡不著？新型藥物與 CBT-I 帶你找回「關機力」
items.x: 台灣人一年吃掉超過 5 億顆安眠藥，平均一天吞下 138 萬顆！難道我們真的這麼難入睡嗎？面對漫漫長夜，許多人依賴藥物來強制大腦關機，但安眠藥吃久了怕成癮、擔心戒不掉，甚至憂慮會引發失智。到底失眠一定要吃藥嗎？吃了十年的藥還有機會戒除嗎？這一集，就讓挺健康鄭丁…

items.t: 科學家在紅海下方一英里多發現神秘湖泊
items.x: 在紅海表面一英里多的地方，科學家發現了罕見的水下湖泊，這些湖泊可以揭示有關地球古代海洋的秘密以及外星生命的可能性。這些極鹹、無氧的環境被稱為鹽水池，令人驚訝地充滿了微生物，挑戰了我們對生物可以生存的理解。
items.orig: Scientists discover mysterious lakes more than a mile beneath the Red Sea
items.origX: More than a mile beneath the surface of the Red Sea, scientists have discovered rare underwater lakes that could reveal secrets about Earth's ancient oceans and the possibility of alien life. Known as brine pools, these extremely salty, oxygen-free environments are surprisingly teeming with microbial life, challenging our understanding of where living organisms can survive.

items.t: 非經典碳正離子合成六取代苯
items.x: 苯環是小分子藥物中最常見的環系1。然而，由於合成方面的挑戰以及市售芳香族結構單元的可用性有限，小分子庫中明顯不存在具有六個取代基的苯。因此，新的化學製程能夠透過可預測的區域化學合成它們
items.orig: Hexa-substituted benzene synthesis with non-classical carbocations
items.origX: Benzene rings are the most frequently encountered ring system in small-molecule drugs1. However, benzenes with six substituents are notably absent from small molecule libraries, owing to challenges associated with their synthesis and the limited availability of commercially available aromatic building blocks2. Therefore, new chemical processes that enable their synthesis with predictable regiochemical control and broad substituent diversity could enable medicinal chemists to explore this uncharted aromatic chemical space in hit-to-lead and lead optimization campaigns. Herein, we describe a highly modular and programmable platform for accessing hexa-substituted benzene rings from aromatic cyclopropenium cations and (trialkylsilyl)allenes, with precise control over all six benzene positions encoded in the starting materials. The exceptional regioselectivity observed originates from the selective evolution of an unusual non-classical carbocation featuring four-centre four-electron bonding as revealed by density functional theory calculations. Our benzannulation enables the selective installation of synthetic handles that were exploited for the synthesis of previously inaccessible penta- and hexa-substituted analogues of the anticancer drug sonidegib and the antihypertensive drug telmisartan, as well as the polyaromatic hydrocarbon triphenylene. Notably, the use of enantiopure allenes unlocks a new route to enantioenriched multi-substituted biaryls through our benzannulation occurring with 「memory of chirality」.
